fixture_placement: <workspace>/fixture_project: placed before turn 1 when no such entry exists; always removed at the end
launch_mode: openclaw gateway run (foreground, started and stopped by the controller); then one openclaw acp process: initialize, session/new, and one session/prompt per turn
model: not set by the controller; the owner default is used and the model that the stdout envelope reports is recorded
native_capture: whole OpenClaw home metadata bracket once, after both turns and after the gateway stopped; files named by the session id or the Codex thread id copied; rows of the test session exported from private temporary copies of agents/main/agent/openclaw-agent.sqlite, agents/main/agent/codex-home/state_5.sqlite, agents/main/agent/codex-home/thread_history_1.sqlite, state/openclaw.sqlite
observer: ACP stream of each turn (tool calls with arguments, status, exit code), helper ledger, file hashes
state: the owner's normal OpenClaw state; no state directory, profile or workspace override
workspace_source: openclaw config get agents.defaults.workspace (read-only CLI call at execution; the configuration file is not read)
